title: Better Than Cubs
description: A resource pack that changes the new 26.1-snapshot-2's baby eyes to the adult eyes
body:
# We are Better Than Cubs!
This resource pack changes the baby eyes added in the snapshot 26.1-snapshot-2 into the older adult eyes as before.

## Mobs that were changed:
- Kittens (cats)
- Pups (wolves)
- Piglets (pigs)
- Baby Cows
- Baby Sheep

Resource pack's name was inspired by [Better Than Wolves](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-than-wolves)
